label: alleged
text: German Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt said the night‑time unrest was caused by violent left‑wing groups and anarchists from the migrant community, but gave no evidence. The claim follows reports of looting and Molotov attacks in Frankfurt and scuffles in Berlin after the daytime rally.

sources.title: See inside the Gen Z protests sweeping Europe as dissent grows - The Washington Post
sources.articleText:
See inside the Gen Z protests sweeping Europe as dissent grows
BERLIN — Thousands of Gen Z-led protesters took to the streets across Germany and other European countries on Halloween, joining a growing wave of youth demonstrations over the rising cost of living, increased military spending, the worsening climate crisis and chronic underinvestment in education.
Lead image: Protesters with a French flag sing on the roof of a bus stop in Paris on Saturday during a demonstration against the high cost of living. (Chloe Sharrock/MYOP/For The Washington Post)
A Berlin protester dressed as Lady Justice poses at the Brandenburg Gate. (Ksenia Ivanova/For The Washington Post)
